## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 3 ago 2026 - 22 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Bib Basters_, 22 sept 2026, 1/5: "1 minute in the app and I have already hit a paywall. switched to other app"
            2. _Anthony Taylor_, 3 ago 2026, 1/5: "I chose Habitify and prepaid for a full year of Premium because it showed an overall daily completion score across my habits and categories. After the update, weekly and monthly habits no longer count, so my score shows 0%. Support confirmed this is intentional. Removing the main feature customers paid for during an active annual subscription is ridiculous and deeply disappointing. Unless it is restored, I will cancel and switch apps."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 10 mar 2026 - 22 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Tom_, 15 ago 2026, 1/5: "bought a lifetime membership, doesn't seem to equate to lifetime development. the app has noticably degraded in terms of performance and bugs"
            2. _Alexander Husted_, 10 mar 2026, 1/5: "After using the app for a while, and paying for lifetime membership, I started having bugs which made the app unusable. I wrote to support, but haven't received an answer. I run it in on a Galaxy S21 with Android 15"
            3. _Alexander Husted_, 22 sept 2026, 3/5: "After using the app for a while, and paying for lifetime membership, I started having bugs which made the app unusable. I wrote to support, but haven't received an answer. I run it in on a Galaxy S21 with Android 15. Update: They fixed the issue that I had, but new ones have been created. I cannot update the of habits, effectivly making it unusable."
<!--/ir-theme-->
